role: Declares the empty value type `OvernightStreamingCoordinator` (holds RRCollector strongly); its behaviour lives in extensions in RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.swift and RRCollector+OvernightArming.swift. The morning gather the doc comment lists is not on this type: gatherOvernightData is an extension of MorningSessionPipeline (RRCollector+OvernightGather.swift:12,20) that only uses this type's nested OvernightDataResult and static hasSufficientOvernightData. Built by `RRCollector.overnightStreaming` (RRCollector+OvernightStreamingForwarding.swift:14).
types: OvernightStreamingCoordinator: struct (@MainActor) — transient handle for overnight-streaming extensions

flags.text: Doc comment says this type covers 'the morning gather', but gatherOvernightData lives on MorningSessionPipeline, not on OvernightStreamingCoordinator.
